page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture is configured with a single thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyper-threading.

This instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

The high memory density relative to compute cores makes this instance class qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require large in-memory datasets but do not scale linearly with CPU requirements. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance. This configuration is suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
